title: New End-to-End Mode-I Adaptive-Remeshing Simulation: New Coarse Solve, Authentic MISESERI Calculation, Automated Indicator-Driven Remeshing, and New Forward Fracture Solve
objectives: Stage 1: Generate a new coarse finite-element model of the 1x1 mm Mode-I specimen and run an authentic Abaqus pre-analysis under benchmark loading.

Stage 2: Calculate the genuine MISESERI/recovery-based error indicator from the new pre-analysis fields, documenting exact recovery formulas, thresholds, and normalization without damage or geometric proxies.
Stage 3: Compute local target-size field from the error indicator and automatically generate an entirely new adapted FE mesh without hardcoded crack corridors or reusing Stage-14 artifacts.
Stage 4: Build a new 3-layer Abaqus production deck from the new adapted mesh, verify datachecks, submit to independent review, and execute new forward fracture solve under authorized PBS operation.
Stage 5: Scientifically compare new forward results with Pandey-Kumar Figures 5(b), 6(a), and 7.
Stage 6: Generate clean figures, commit and push to GitHub, and provide new PBS receipts, hashes, and direct figure links.
